about_short_description.short_description: UpBanx is a next-generation financial technology platform for creators, brands, freelancers, agencies, and beyond.

product.name: Financing
product.description: Provides invoice financing with an admin fee of 1.8–2.5% per month, allowing users to access funds in advance based on their invoices.

product.name: Invoice Generator
product.description: Allows users to create, share, and send invoice reminders easily within the app to manage billing and payments.

product.name: Financial Statement
product.description: Generates clear and easy-to-understand financial reports from user financial data within seconds.

product.name: UpThinx AI-powered Content Generator
product.description: An AI tool that generates on-brand content copy based on company and product information provided by the user.

product.name: Bank Transfer Service
product.description: Facilitates fund transfers with defined transaction limits and associated fees, integrated within the UpBanx app.
